resolution.note: krn pr body --worktree PATH reads tasks/ and commits from that worktree; test proves a worktree-only task renders Problem and Task while the main checkout exits 64 Unknown task

title: krn pr body finds a task created in the branch it describes
body:
Outcome: `krn pr body --task <id>` finds a task created in the PR's own branch (it reads the worktree's tasks/ when given --worktree or run inside it) instead of exiting 2 with "Unknown task".
Why: on #597 the lead created t-v99074z inside the lane worktree and `krn pr body --task t-v99074z` from the main checkout failed, so the body was written by hand against the template.
Proof: a test creates a task only in a worktree and sees `krn pr body --task <id> --worktree <path>` print its Problem and Task sections.
Scope: the pr body command and its test.
